critic.fix_suggestion: Replace the single nose protrusion with a linear array of 6 small rectangular planes (0.5x0.3 units) arranged horizontally along the upper fuselage curve, spaced 1.2 units apart to simulate individual cockpit windows.

discrepancies.observed: A single large blocky protrusion at the nose
discrepancies.reference: A distinct row of multiple individual cockpit windows
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: replace with a series of small rectangular planes

discrepancies.observed: No visible window markings or lines on the main body
discrepancies.reference: A continuous, long horizontal line of many small circular/oval windows along the fuselage
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add a row of repeated small cylinders or thin rectangles along the side

discrepancies.observed: Smooth, uninterrupted fuselage surface with no door markings
discrepancies.reference: Clearly defined rectangular outlines for front and rear cabin doors
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: add two large vertical rectangular planes slightly inset into the fuselage sides

discrepancies.observed: A sharp, angular transition from the cockpit area to the main body
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous aerodynamic curve from nose to cabin
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase radius of the nose cone primitive
